<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAlertDialog, type UseAlertDialogProps, type UseAlertDialogEmits } from "../alert-dialog/use-alert-dialog";
import { provideAlertDialogContext } from "../alert-dialog/use-alert-dialog-context";

const props = defineProps<UseAlertDialogProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<UseAlertDialogEmits>();

const api = useAlertDialog(props, emit);
provideAlertDialogContext(api);
</script>

<template>
  <slot />
</template>

Heads up!
You can add components to your app using the cli.

<view class="{{className}}">
  <!-- Trigger (optional) -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{showTrigger}}"
    bindtap="onTriggerTap"
  >
    <slot name="trigger"></slot>
  </view>

  <!-- Backdrop -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}"
    class="alert-dialog-backdrop"
    bindtap="onBackdropTap"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  ></view>

  <!-- Dialog Content -->
  <view 
    wx:if="{{api.open}}"
    id="{{api.contentProps.id}}"
    class="alert-dialog-content"
    role="{{role}}"
    data-state="{{api.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}}"
  >
    <!-- Header -->
    <view class="alert-dialog-header">
      <text 
        id="{{api.titleProps.id}}"
        class="alert-dialog-title"
      >
        <slot name="title">{{title}}</slot>
      </text>
      <view 
        wx:if="{{showClose}}"
        class="alert-dialog-close" 
        bindtap="onCloseTap"
      >×</view>
    </view>

    <!-- Body -->
    <view 
      id="{{api.descriptionProps.id}}"
      class="alert-dialog-body"
    >
      <slot name="description">{{description}}</slot>
    </view>

    <!-- Footer -->
    <view class="alert-dialog-footer">
      <slot name="footer">
        <view class="alert-dialog-actions">
          <view 
            class="alert-dialog-cancel-btn" 
            bindtap="onCancelTap"
          >
            {{cancelText || '取消'}}
          </view>
          <view 
            class="alert-dialog-confirm-btn" 
            bindtap="onConfirmTap"
          >
            {{confirmText || '确认'}}
          </view>
        </view>
      </slot>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
